name: OpenXcom
author: Northfear
description: OpenXcom is an open-source clone of the popular "UFO: Enemy Unknown" ("X-COM: UFO Defense" in the USA release) and "X-COM: Terror From the Deep" videogames by Microprose, licensed under the GPL and written in C++ / SDL.
requirements:
- fd_fix.skprx OR repatch_ex.skprx
- Game Data Files: PC
